replacements.before: ~solemn~ The makers kept a cold tool in there. Quiet what she hears, and she might listen.
replacements.after: ~solemn~ Use the cold tool on the jangling crystals above her. Once they’re still, she might listen.

replacements.before: ~solemn~ Offer it a little light at a time. Wait for it to settle between tries.
replacements.after: ~solemn~ Let a bubble take light from a lit pool, then send it to the moth when it hangs low. Stand back while it drinks.
